 Board Exam Time Table 2027: Check state-wise Class 10 and 12 exam updates. (Representative Image: Shutterstock) The Tamil Nadu Directorate of Government Examinations (DGE) has announced the TN 10th and 12th public exam dates 2027. TN 10th public exams 2027 will be held from March 17 to April 12, 2027 and HSC 12th exams will be held from March 3 to March 29. While, other states are expected to announce their board exam details soon.
 Many state education boards have also announced their schedule for Class 10 and 12 board examinations 2027. The Uttar Pradesh Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad (UPMSP) has announced the UP Board timetable 2027, with exams scheduled from February 5 to 24, 2027. Maharashtra HSC exams will be held from February 8 to March 16, while SSC exams are scheduled from February 15 to March 11, 2027.
 The Tamil Nadu Directorate of Government Examinations (DGE) will announce the Tamil Nadu SSLC, Class 11 and Class 12 public examination schedule today at 12:30 pm.
Madhya Pradesh Board of Secondary Education (MPBSE) has also published its MPBSE exam timetable 2027 . Meanwhile, Karnataka SSLC Exam 1 is scheduled from March 22 to April 5, followed by Exam 2 from May 24 to 31.
 Students awaiting the AP Intermediate, Tamil Nadu SSLC and Rajasthan Board (RBSE) date sheets should check the respective official websites for the latest announcements.
